purpose: Per Q4 — assert wire-protocol parity between UI form field names + JS submit payloads + HTTP request bodies + server handler reads + DB column names for every behavioral surface touched by Phase 3. Each row binds (a) UI form field/input id/name, (b) the wire name on POST/PATCH JSON body, (c) the server handler's body-field read, (d) the DB column it persists into. Verified by the named source files and the named tests.

rows.trigger: Admin domains page -> 'New Site' button -> submit form
red_line_substitutions_forbidden: MUST NOT use legacy 'site_name' on the wire (WARN-FIX-3 migration completed in T3)
MUST NOT use legacy 'site_id' as a DB column for the canonical id (sites.site_id legacy; sites.id is the canonical PK in 0002+)

tests.expected: >= 1 matching line
POST /api/admin/sites request body parses as JSON containing the literal key 'name' (NOT 'site_name'), response is 201 with site_id, and Domains table re-renders with the new row

rows.trigger: Internal site-provisioning runner invoked 15 times after a sites row is INSERTed
red_line_substitutions_forbidden: MUST NOT run a 16th provisioning step (idempotent contract — T4.AC1)
MUST NOT emit outbound fetch to api.cloudflare.com during SITE_PROVISIONING_DRY_RUN=true (T12.AC1)

tests.expected: POST /provision/next invoked 15 times -> site_creation_jobs has 1 row, site_creation_job_steps has 15 rows all status='completed'; 16th invocation is idempotent (no new rows)
COUNT(*) site_creation_job_steps WHERE job_id=latest = 15
COUNT(*) pages WHERE page_type='about' AND site_id=X = 1
fetch spy receives zero calls targeting api.cloudflare.com during dry-run
COUNT(*) cache_purge_log WHERE dry_run=1 >= 1

rows.surface: PATCH /api/admin/articles/:id (tenant boundary + per-site slug uniqueness + category vertical validation + allow-list field gating)
rows.trigger: Admin articles page -> edit article -> submit
red_line_substitutions_forbidden: MUST NOT bypass assertTenantBoundary (cross-site PATCH must return 403 with tenant_violation, T5.AC2 / T11.AC1)
MUST NOT allow duplicate slug per-site (T5.AC3 / T11.AC2 -> 409)
MUST NOT allow category whose vertical is not in site.allowed_verticals (T5 -> 422)
MUST NOT accept fields outside the allow-list (T5)

tests.expected: >= 4 cases (tenant boundary 403, slug duplicate 409, category mismatch 422, allow-list gating)
cross-site PATCH -> 403 + body contains tenant_violation
duplicate slug PATCH -> 409
assertTenantBoundary throws TenantViolation; PATCH -> 403
assertSlugUniquePerSite throws SlugConflict 409

red_line_substitutions_forbidden: MUST NOT bump settings_version on sites other than the targeted site_id (T8.AC1)
MUST NOT execute UPDATE site_settings without WHERE site_id=? (global update forbidden)

tests.expected: PATCH on site X -> site_settings.settings_version (X) = N+1 AND site_settings.settings_version (Y) unchanged

rows.surface: Media + Tags admin list filters -> GET /api/admin/{media,tags}?site_id=X
rows.trigger: Admin media or tags page -> site_id select -> filter
red_line_substitutions_forbidden: MUST NOT use legacy 'site' shorthand in template select inputs (WARN-FIX-4 migration completed in T10)
MUST NOT return tags / media from other sites when site_id filter is applied (T10.AC2)

tests.expected: >= 1 matching line
GET /api/admin/tags?site_id=A returns exactly 3 rows (site A has 3 tags; site B has 2 — excluded)
listMediaForSite(X) returns 5 rows (3 site-scoped + 2 global)

rows.surface: Pages admin filter + provisioning About-page insert
rows.trigger: Admin pages page -> site_id + page_type filter | Provisioning runner step REQ-020
rows.endpoint: GET /admin/pages?site_id=X&page_type=about | internal pages INSERT via runner
rows.endpoint_source: api/src/admin/ui.ts (admin page render) + api/src/site-provisioning/steps.ts (About page insert)
red_line_substitutions_forbidden: MUST NOT render pages from other site_ids when site_id filter is active (T6.AC1)
MUST NOT insert > 1 About page per site_id (T6.AC2 / T4.AC3 — idempotent provisioning)

tests.expected: select[name=site_id] AND select[name=page_type] with option value='about' rendered in /admin/pages
after provisioning -> COUNT(*) pages WHERE page_type='about' AND site_id=X = 1

rows.surface: POST /api/admin/categories with multi-vertical allocation -> category_verticals rows
rows.trigger: Admin categories page -> 'New category' -> select 1..N verticals -> submit
red_line_substitutions_forbidden: MUST NOT insert category_verticals rows where vertical_id is not in site.allowed_verticals (T7.AC2 -> 422)
MUST NOT silently drop verticals from the array — every passed vertical_id MUST be inserted (T7.AC1 -> exactly 3 rows for vertical_ids:[1,2,3])

site.allowed_verticals=[1,2,3] + POST vertical_ids:[1,4] -> 422 + zero rows inserted
